name: PNB 2775
title: Enhanced Human Physiology and Anatomy II
description: Fundamentals of human physiology and anatomy enhanced through discussion. A focus on organ systems, including the cardiovascular, respiratory, lymphatic, digestive, renal, and reproductive systems.
requirement_description: PNB 2774. Not open to students who have passed PNB 2265 or PNB 2275. Repeat restrictions apply; see advising.uconn.edu/repeat-policy for information.
